properties.displayName: OT - Devices Seen for the First Time in 14 Days
properties.query:
let known = CommonSecurityLog | where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(1d)) | distinct DeviceName;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| join kind=leftanti (known) on DeviceName
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), Events = count() by DeviceName, DeviceVendor

tags.name: description
tags.value: Devices appearing in CEF/syslog telemetry that were never seen in the prior 14 days. In a static OT network, new talkers are either commissioning work or a problem. Run weekly; reconcile against the critical-assets watchlist and commissioning schedule.
